/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    HousingQA
    - State: Puerto Rico
    - Focus year: 2021
    Question: Does the law prohibit rental agreements from including a provision allowing
              a landlord to evict a tenant because they contacted law enforcement services,
              health services, or safety services?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (facts)
   ========================= */

scenario_state(puerto_rico).
scenario_year(2021).

rental_agreement(lease_1).

% The lease contains a provision allowing eviction because the tenant contacted services.
service(law_enforcement_services).
service(health_services).
service(safety_services).

provision(lease_1, provision_1).
provision_allows_eviction_because_tenant_contacted_service(provision_1, law_enforcement_services).
provision_allows_eviction_because_tenant_contacted_service(provision_1, health_services).
provision_allows_eviction_because_tenant_contacted_service(provision_1, safety_services).

/* scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the question's factual statement is fully captured. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(puerto_rico),
    scenario_year(2021),
    rental_agreement(Lease),
    provision(Lease, Prov),
    provision_allows_eviction_because_tenant_contacted_service(Prov, law_enforcement_services),
    provision_allows_eviction_because_tenant_contacted_service(Prov, health_services),
    provision_allows_eviction_because_tenant_contacted_service(Prov, safety_services).

/* =========================
   Statutes (translated to logic)
   ========================= */

% --- PR Laws tit. 1,  481 (2020)
% Spanish: "El arrendatario de una finca de beneficio proporcional reunirá los requisitos que fije la Autoridad."
% Encoding: A tenant of a "finca de beneficio proporcional" must meet the requirements set by the Authority.

statute_pr_1_481_authority_sets_requirements(puerto_rico, authority, tenant_of_finca_beneficio_proporcional).

legal_obligation_meet_authority_requirements(State, TenantType) :-
    statute_pr_1_481_authority_sets_requirements(State, authority, TenantType).

/* =========================
   Reasoning: prohibition on lease clauses re eviction for contacting services?
   ========================= */

% This predicate represents any statutory prohibition (in the provided statutes)
% against including a lease provision allowing eviction due to contacting services.
% Under the provided statute set, there is no such prohibition.
statute_prohibits_including_eviction_for_contact_clause(_State, _Year) :-
    fail.

legal_prohibits_including_eviction_for_contact_clause(State, Year) :-
    statute_prohibits_including_eviction_for_contact_clause(State, Year).

/* =========================
   Answer
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    legal_prohibits_including_eviction_for_contact_clause(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).
